description: This file defines an interface ILogViewAdaptorFactory within the Orleans.EventSourcing namespace, which specifies methods and properties for creating log view adaptors in the Orleans distributed framework.

classes.name: ILogViewAdaptorFactory
classes.description: Interface for a factory that constructs log view adaptors, including properties to specify storage usage and a method to create adaptors with specific parameters.

methods.name: MakeLogViewAdaptor
methods.description: Creates a log view adaptor for specific log view and entry types, configured with host grain, initial state, grain type name, storage provider, and services.
